elements.name: TextBox 10
elements.text:
• Library: tsfresh (EfficientFCParameters)
• ~750+ features per channel per window
• Window: 5 seconds (500 samples)
• Step: 2.5 seconds (50% overlap)
• Channels: 9 (L1–L8 + TotalLeft) per foot

Per-subject aggregation:
  → Mean across windows
  → Std across windows
  → Skewness across windows
  → Kurtosis across windows

Final matrix: 80 subjects × ~3,000 features
Applied: z-score normalisation (StandardScaler)

elements.name: TextBox 12
elements.text:
15 features per channel per window:
  · Mean, Std, Min, Max
  · Skewness, Kurtosis
  · Q25, Q75 (interquartile range)
  · Mean |Δ|, Std Δ  (first diff)
  · Range, CV (coefficient of variation)
  · Signal energy (mean x²)
  · Dominant frequency (FFT)
  · Low-frequency energy

Advantages over TSFresh:
  → Faster (seconds vs. hours)
  → Interpretable (domain knowledge)
  → Less prone to overfitting

Final matrix: 80 subjects × 60–120 features
Applied: z-score normalisation (StandardScaler)
